answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 50 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an island bet on surviving 50 epochs of grading, and every quill settlement recomputes the glacier schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
